Subcontractors.Title: Subcontractor Marketplace Access
Subcontractors.Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Registration
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to register on the platform by providing my personal and business details, so that I can access the job marketplace and find property maintenance and repair work.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can enter personal details including name, email, and phone number.
Subcontractor can enter business details including business name, type, and services offered.
Subcontractor must verify their phone number through OTP.
The system must send an activation link to the subcontractor’s email for account activation.
Subcontractor can set a password for login credentials.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Login
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to log into the platform using my registered credentials, so that I can access my profile and job marketplace.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can log in using email and password.
Subcontractor can request a password reset link if they forget their password.
The system should provide ‘Remember Me’ functionality to facilitate easier logins on return visits.

User Stories.Title: View Job Listings
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view a list of available jobs in my set radius/working area, so that I can apply for jobs that match my skills and preferences.
AcceptanceCriteria: Job listings must be displayed with essential details like location, job description, and estimated pay.
Subcontractor can filter job listings by categories such as electrical, plumbing, etc.
Subcontractor can view details of a job by selecting it from the list.

User Stories.Title: Apply for Jobs
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to apply for jobs by submitting a proposal, so that property managers can consider me for the work.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can submit a proposal including a cover letter, estimated cost, and timeframe.
Subcontractor can attach supporting documents to their proposal.
Subcontractor receives confirmation upon successful submission of a job application.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive notifications about job application statuses and other relevant updates, so that I am informed about opportunities and changes in real time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor receives an email and in-app notification when their job application is accepted or rejected.
Subcontractor receives alerts for new jobs posted within their service area.

User Stories.Title: Manage Profile and Services
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to manage my profile and the services I offer, so that potential clients can view up-to-date information about my business.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can update personal and business information in their profile.
Subcontractor can add or remove services they provide.
Changes must be saved and reflected immediately on the platform.

User Stories.Title: Manage Payment Information
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to manage my payment details securely on the platform, so that I can receive payments directly to my account for completed jobs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can add or update their bank information.
The platform must comply with Canadian law for data protection.
Subcontractor can remove existing bank details.

Subcontractors.Title: Job Application Management
Subcontractors.Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Job Application Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to create and submit job applications so that I can apply for specific job postings relevant to my skills.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can access a job application form from their dashboard.
Form includes fields for job specifics, expected compensation, and project duration.
Subcontractor can attach relevant documents or images.
Application can be saved as a draft before submitting.
Confirmation message appears after successful submission.

User Stories.Title: View and Manage Job Applications
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view, track, and manage my job applications to monitor the status of my bids and make necessary updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can view a list of all job applications submitted.
Each application in the list shows its current status (pending, accepted, rejected).
Subcontractor can edit and update their applications until they are reviewed.
Subcontractor can withdraw their application if it has not been accepted yet.

User Stories.Title: Job Application Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive notifications regarding the status of my job applications so that I am informed of any updates or changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications for job application status updates (accepted, rejected, feedback) are automatically sent to the subcontractor.
Subcontractor can view notifications in a dedicated section.
Email notifications are sent in addition to in-platform notifications.

User Stories.Title: Job Application History
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to access a history of all my job applications to review past applications and learn from feedback.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can access a historical view of all job applications.
History includes details of the job, application status, and feedback from employers.
Filter and search functionality to find specific applications by date, job title, or status.

User Stories.Title: Feedback System for Job Applications
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive feedback on my rejected applications so that I can improve future applications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feedback is provided for each rejected application, visible in the application details.
Feedback section includes comments from the employer on why the application was rejected.
Subcontractor can request further clarification on feedback via a messaging feature.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login and Account Management
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to securely log into the platform and manage my account settings to ensure my personal and application data is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Secure login process with email and password.
Forgot password and password reset functionalities.
Profile management features to update personal details, credentials, and communication preferences.

Subcontractors.Title: Communication and Coordination
Subcontractors.Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.

User Stories.Title: Login to Communication Platform
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to be able to log in securely to the chat system so that I can access my messages and communicate with property managers and tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login page is accessible from the main website.
Subcontractors can log in using their registered email and password.
System validates credentials and denies access with incorrect login details.
Redirect to the main communication dashboard upon successful login.

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery for Chat System
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to recover my password via email if I forget it so that I can regain access to the chat system.
AcceptanceCriteria: Password recovery option is available on the login page.
Subcontractors can enter their registered email to receive a password reset link.
Subcontractors can reset their password using the link sent to their email.
Subcontractors can log in with the new password after resetting.

User Stories.Title: Send Direct Messages
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to send direct messages to property managers and tenants so that I can discuss job details and respond to queries.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to select a recipient from a list of contacts which includes property managers and tenants.
Text box to type messages and a send button.
Sent messages are visible in the chat window.
Recipients receive messages in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Receive and View Messages
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to receive and view messages from property managers and tenants so that I can keep up-to-date with job requirements and scheduling.
AcceptanceCriteria: Incoming messages are notified with an alert.
Messages are displayed in chronological order in the chat window.
Subcontractors can view the sender’s name and message timestamp.
Read/unread status is visible for each message.

User Stories.Title: Create Group Chats
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to create group chats including myself, tenants, and property managers so that we can coordinate more efficiently on projects requiring multiple stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option to create a new group chat from the communication dashboard.
Ability to select multiple contacts to add to the group chat.
Group chat allows for messages to be sent and received by all members.
Members receive notifications when added to a group chat.

User Stories.Title: Upload and Share Files
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to upload and share files within the chat system so that I can provide visual details or documents related to the maintenance jobs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feature to attach files within the message composer.
Support for common file types (e.g., PDF, JPG, DOCX).
Files are scanned for viruses upon upload.
Recipients can download and view files directly from the chat.

User Stories.Title: Archive and Search Conversations
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to archive and search past conversations so that I can refer back to old messages and maintain a clean and organized chat environment.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option to archive conversations.
Archived messages are stored but can be accessed if needed.
Search functionality to find specific messages or conversations by keyword.
Search results display relevant messages and their context.

Subcontractors.Title: Profile and Credentials Management
Subcontractors.Description: Allow subcontractors to create and manage their profiles, showcasing their credentials, past work, and areas of expertise to enhance their visibility in the marketplace.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Profile Creation
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to create and customize my profile so that I can showcase my credentials, past work, and areas of expertise.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can access a registration form.
Fields include: name, contact information, skill set, certifications, and portfolio uploads (images, documents).
Profile creation must be confirmed by email verification.
Subcontractor can view and edit profile after creation.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Profile Visibility
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want my profile to be publicly visible on the marketplace so that potential clients can view my expertise and past projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Profile should be searchable and accessible by other users.
Visibility options available to the subcontractor: public, private, or to specific property managers.
Profile must include subcontractor's credentials, specialties, reviews and ratings.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Credential Upload
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to upload and update my certifications and credentials so that I can enhance trust with potential clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to upload digital copies of credentials and certificates.
Support for multiple file formats (PDF, JPG, PNG).
Facility to update or remove outdated credentials.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Portfolio Management
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to manage a portfolio of my past projects so that I can showcase my experience and quality of work to potential clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to add, edit, and delete project entries.
Each entry can include images, a project description, and a link to the project case study.
Ability to categorize projects based on the type of work (e.g., electrical, plumbing).

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Profile Searchability and Filters
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want my profile to be easily searchable with filters so that property managers can find me based on relevant criteria.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property managers can search for subcontractors based on location, specialty, and ratings.
Filters for the type of service (e.g., plumbing, electrical), availability, and previous client reviews.
Search results display relevant matches with an option to view detailed profiles.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Availability Settings
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to set my availability within my profile so that property managers know when I am available for projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to set standard availability in the profile settings.
Options to mark specific dates as unavailable.
Automatic updates to property managers viewing the profile regarding availability status.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Ratings and Reviews
User Stories.Description: As a subcontractor, I want to receive ratings and reviews from property managers so that I can build my reputation in the marketplace.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property managers can post reviews and rate subcontractors after a project is completed.
Subcontractors can respond to reviews.
Aggregate rating displayed on the subcontractor's profile.

Subcontractors.Title: Financial Transaction Management
Subcontractors.Description: Provide a secure platform for subcontractors to receive payments for completed jobs through integrated financial services like Stripe, including managing invoices and transaction history.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to log in to the platform using my registered credentials so that I can access my secure personal and financial information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can enter username and password
Successful login directs to the Subcontractor dashboard
Unsuccessful login provides an error message and the option to reset the password

User Stories.Title: Invoice Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to generate invoices automatically after completing a job so that I can ensure timely and accurate billing to the property managers or tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Automatically generate an invoice upon job completion
Invoice includes detailed information such as job description, hours worked, rate, and total cost
Subcontractor can review and edit the invoice before sending

User Stories.Title: View Payment History
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view my payment history so that I can track all my received payments and manage my financial records efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Access to a payment history tab on the dashboard
List all payments received with dates and amounts
Option to download payment records as a CSV file

User Stories.Title: Stripe Integration for Receiving Payments
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive payments through Stripe integration so that I can ensure secure and reliable transaction processing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with Stripe for receiving payments
Confirmation of payment received is visible in the subcontractor's dashboard
Subcontractors can withdraw or transfer funds to their bank account from Stripe

User Stories.Title: Manage Bank Details
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to add and manage my bank details so that I can receive payments directly to my preferred account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option to add and edit bank details in profile settings
Secure storage of bank information
Bank details are used for transactions processed through Stripe

User Stories.Title: Password Reset
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account without compromising security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option to reset password via a linked email
Receive an email with a password reset link
Must be able to set a new password following security standards

Subcontractors.Title: Feedback and Ratings
Subcontractors.Description: Implement a system where subcontractors can receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants, helping to build their reputation in the community.

User Stories.Title: Subcontractor Profile Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to create and manage my profile so that I can present my skills and services to property managers and tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractor can register with email, phone number, and password.
Subcontractor can provide details such as services offered, certifications, and past work experience.
Profile changes must be saved and updated immediately in the database.
Subcontractors can view their profile to confirm accurate display of provided information.

User Stories.Title: Receive Feedback and Ratings
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants after job completion so that I can build my reputation and attract more work.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractors can view all feedback and ratings left by tenants and property managers.
Feedback includes a numerical rating and a text comment.
Feedback and ratings are visible on the subcontractor's public profile.
There should be a functionality to respond to feedback within the platform.

User Stories.Title: View Job Listings and Apply
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to view available job listings and apply to them so that I can secure work engagements.
AcceptanceCriteria: List of available jobs is accessible to logged-in subcontractors.
Jobs can be filtered by type, location, and urgency.
Application process allows submission of a proposal and expected cost.
Subcontractors receive a confirmation upon successful job application submission.

User Stories.Title: Job Completion and Initiation of Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to mark jobs as completed and initiate the feedback process so that I can ensure my services are adequately reviewed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractors can mark a job as completed in the system.
Upon marking as completed, the property manager and tenant are notified to leave feedback.
The system should capture the date of completion.
A reminder for feedback submission is sent to the property manager and tenant if not submitted within a specified timeframe.

User Stories.Title: Access to Feedback History
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to access my historical feedback and ratings to evaluate my performance over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Subcontractors can access a dashboard showing all past feedback and ratings.
Feedback history can be filtered by date, job type, or property manager.
The system provides average rating calculation based on historical data.
Feedback details are expandable for full review directly on the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Dispute Resolution Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Subcontractor, I want to be able to dispute unfair ratings or feedback to maintain my reputation integrity.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feature to flag feedback for review available on the subcontractor's dashboard.
Flagger must provide a reason and any evidence supporting their dispute claim.
Disputed feedback is reviewed by an administrator with a response time of no more than 5 business days.
Subcontractors are notified of the dispute outcome, and adjustments are made if necessary.

Property Managers.Title: Property Listing Management
Property Managers.Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.

User Stories.Title: Add Property Listing
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to add property listings so that I can advertise available properties to potential tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can enter property details including name, address, description, property type, and photos.
System must validate entered data for completeness and correctness.
Upon successful submission, the property listing should be visible on the platform.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing addition.

User Stories.Title: Update Property Listing
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to update property listings to ensure all information is current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can select an existing listing and update any of the details including descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos.
System must validate updated data for completeness and correctness.
Changes should be immediately reflected on the platform upon submission.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing update.

User Stories.Title: Remove Property Listing
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to remove property listings that are no longer available to rent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can select an existing listing and remove it from the platform.
System should prompt for confirmation before deletion to prevent accidental removals.
Once confirmed and removed, the listing should no longer be visible or searchable on the platform.
Property Manager receives confirmation of listing removal.

User Stories.Title: View Listing Details
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view detailed information of property listings so that I can oversee all listings under my management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can select a listing and view all details including descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos.
All details should be presented clearly and be easily readable.
Property Managers can navigate back to the listing overview seamlessly.

User Stories.Title: Search and Filter Listings
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to search and filter property listings to easily find specific properties or types of properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can use a search bar to enter search criteria.
Property Manager can apply filters such as location, property type, and availability status.
Results should update in real-time as filters are applied.
Listings matching the criteria are displayed; if no matches are found, an appropriate message is shown.

User Stories.Title: Login and Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to securely log in to manage property listings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login page accessible from the main website.
Secure authentication with username and password.
Forgot password and reset functionality.
Session timeouts for security.

Property Managers.Title: Lease Management
Property Managers.Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.

User Stories.Title: Create Lease Agreement
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to create lease agreements using templates so that I can efficiently prepare contracts for new tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to select from predefined or previously used templates.
Customize templates with specific lease details (e.g., rent amount, duration).
Preview lease agreement before finalizing.

User Stories.Title: E-Sign Lease Agreement
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want tenants to e-sign the lease agreements via DocuSign so that the lease process is expedited and legally binding.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with DocuSign for e-signing functionality.
Notification to property manager when a tenant has signed the document.
Secure storage of signed documents accessible via the platform.

User Stories.Title: Update Lease Agreement
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to be able to modify existing lease agreements so that I can update terms according to new agreements or corrections.
AcceptanceCriteria: Functionality to select existing lease and make modifications.
Track changes made to the lease documents.
Re-submit for e-signing if significant changes are made.

User Stories.Title: Renew Lease Agreement
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to easily renew lease agreements so that I can retain tenants and ensure continuous occupancy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option to renew an existing lease with the same terms or updated conditions.
Automatic notification to tenants about upcoming lease expirations.
Quick re-signing process via DocuSign.

User Stories.Title: Terminate Lease Agreement
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to terminate lease agreements when necessary so that I can end the contract legally and make the unit available for new tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Functionality to mark a lease as terminated with reasons.
Notification to tenant regarding lease termination.
Archiving of the terminated lease documentation.

User Stories.Title: Lease Duration Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage lease durations so that I can ensure contracts are up-to-date and comply with legal standards.
AcceptanceCriteria: Track start and end dates of all leases.
Alerts for leases nearing their end date.
Options to extend or modify the lease duration directly from the dashboard.

Property Managers.Title: Financial Transactions and Reporting
Property Managers.Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.

User Stories.Title: Integrate Stripe for Rent Payments
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to integrate Stripe for processing rent payments so that I can securely collect monthly rent from tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ensure secure Stripe integration for rent transactions.
Ensure data encryption for sensitive information during transactions.
Provide confirmation of payment to both tenant and property manager via email and in-app notification.
Log all transactions in the system for future reference and reporting.

User Stories.Title: Security Deposit Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage security deposits through Stripe so that I can securely hold and return deposits according to lease terms.
AcceptanceCriteria: Allow collection of security deposits during lease signing.
Securely store deposit information in the platform.
Automate the return of deposits upon lease termination, minus any damages costs.
Provide detailed transaction records for both manager and tenant.

User Stories.Title: Service Fee Collection
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to automatically collect a service fee from subcontractors after each completed job so that I can maintain revenue from marketplace activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Automatically calculate and deduct a 3% service fee from subcontractor payments through Stripe.
Provide real-time updates of fee deductions to subcontractors.
Record all fee transactions for financial reporting.

User Stories.Title: Financial Reporting and Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to generate financial reports and analytics so that I can monitor the financial performance of properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Generate monthly financial reports on rents, deposits, and service fees.
Offer analytics on payment trends and overdue accounts.
Enable downloading of reports in PDF format.
Ensure reports are accessible only by authorized staff.

User Stories.Title: Automate Late Payment Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want the system to automatically notify tenants of late payments so that I can ensure timely rent collection.
AcceptanceCriteria: Send automatic email and in-app notifications to tenants within one day of missed payment deadline.
Provide property managers the ability to customize the notification message.
Log all notifications sent for record-keeping and follow-up.

Property Managers.Title: Maintenance Request Coordination
Property Managers.Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.

User Stories.Title: User Login & Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to be able to securely log in to the platform so that I can access my dashboard and manage maintenance requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Secure login page using registered credentials
Session management with timeout for security
Functionality for 'Forgot Password' to recover access

User Stories.Title: View Maintenance Requests
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view a list of all maintenance and repair requests submitted by tenants so that I can track and prioritize tasks effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: List all maintenance requests in an organized dashboard
Filter requests by status (Pending, Accepted, Rejected, and Completed)
Option to view detailed descriptions and attached documents or images

User Stories.Title: Delegate Tasks to Subcontractors
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to delegate repair tasks to available subcontractors so that maintenance issues are resolved promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Function to assign tasks to subcontractors directly from the maintenance request list
Notification system to alert subcontractors of new assignments
Subcontractors can accept or reject tasks

User Stories.Title: Manage and Update Task Status
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to update and track the status of each maintenance task so that I can keep tenants informed and ensure timely resolution of issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: Update task statuses (Pending, In Progress, Completed)
Automated notifications to tenants upon status updates
Log and track changes in the maintenance request dashboard

User Stories.Title: Review and Approve Subcontractor Work
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to review completed work by subcontractors to ensure quality before marking tasks as completed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to review work reports and uploaded proof of work (photos/documents)
Approve or request rework based on satisfaction
Finalize payment and close tasks upon approval

User Stories.Title: Payment Processing for Subcontractors
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to process payments to subcontractors through the platform to streamline financial transactions and maintain records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with payment systems like Stripe for direct payments
Record and track payment statuses within the platform
Generate invoices and receipts for bookkeeping purposes

User Stories.Title: Access Control and Permissions
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to ensure that access to sensitive information is controlled based on user roles to maintain platform security and data privacy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Define and enforce role-based access controls
Restrict tenant's access to other tenants' and subcontractors' personal data
Audit trails for monitoring access and activities within the platform

Property Managers.Title: Tenant Management
Property Managers.Description: Oversee tenant profiles, rental applications, tenant verification via SingleKey, and maintain a communication channel between property managers and tenants.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Profile Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to create and manage tenant profiles so that I can keep track of tenant information and rental history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to create a new tenant profile with fields for personal, contact, and financial information.
Functionality for updating and deleting tenant profiles.
Profiles must include necessary identification for SingleKey verification.
System must securely store and handle sensitive tenant data in compliance with Canadian Law.

User Stories.Title: Rental Application Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage rental applications so that I can efficiently process potential tenant requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to receive and review rental applications through the platform.
Functionality to accept or reject applications with reasons for decision.
Notification system to inform tenants of application status automatically.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Verification Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to integrate SingleKey for tenant verification to ensure tenant reliability and reduce rental risks.
AcceptanceCriteria: SingleKey API integration for conducting credit and background checks.
Capability for tenants to pay for their verification if required by property manager.
Verification status should be updated in tenant profiles upon completion.

User Stories.Title: Communication Channel Setup
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to maintain a communication channel between myself, tenants, and subcontractors so that we can coordinate effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: In-app messaging functionality for one-to-one and group conversations.
Ability to share documents and images within chats.
Chat history should be stored securely and be easily accessible.

User Stories.Title: Access Control and Permissions
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage access controls and permissions within the platform to ensure data privacy and appropriate access to information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Different access levels for tenants, property managers, and subcontractors.
Tenants should only access their profile, rental details, and communication features.
Subcontractors should have limited access, primarily to job-related features and chats.

User Stories.Title: Rental Lease Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to oversee lease agreements and renewals to manage property rental effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to create, send, and manage digital lease agreements via DocuSign integration.
Notifications for lease expirations and renewals should be automated.
Functionality for tenants to e-sign and return documents seamlessly within the platform.

Property Managers.Title: Appointment Scheduling
Property Managers.Description: Integrate with Calendly to facilitate the scheduling of property visits for tenants and subcontractors, and manage calendar views for availability.

User Stories.Title: Login Access for Property Managers
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to be able to log in securely so that I can access my dashboard to manage property visits and availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can log in using email and password
Session management must be secure
Should have options for 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'

User Stories.Title: Setup Integration with Calendly
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to integrate Calendly into the platform so that I can manage scheduling property visits efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Calendly integration setup is confirmed in the backend
Property managers can view and manage Calendly calendar from their dashboard
Ensure the Calendly API is connected and functioning properly for scheduling

User Stories.Title: View Calendar for Property Availability
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view a calendar of property availability so that I can easily see when properties are available for visits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Calendar view is integrated into the property manager dashboard
Calendar shows all current bookings and availability
Property managers can adjust availability directly from the calendar view

User Stories.Title: Manage Appointment Requests
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage appointment requests so that I can accept or reject bookings based on my availability and tenant requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard includes a section for managing incoming appointment requests
Property managers can accept or reject appointments with a single click
Notifications are sent to tenants and subcontractors upon acceptance or rejection

User Stories.Title: Configure Notification Settings
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to configure notification settings so that I can receive updates about booking requests and changes to the schedule.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to set preferences for receiving email and in-app notifications about booking activities
Notifications for new booking requests, confirmations, and cancellations
Customizable settings for notification frequency and types

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want a password recovery feature so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.
AcceptanceCriteria: Password recovery option available on the login page
Security questions or email verification to confirm identity
Ability to reset password securely

Property Managers.Title: Access and Permission Controls
Property Managers.Description: Define and manage access permissions across different functionalities of the platform to secure sensitive information and operations.

User Stories.Title: Login Authentication for Property Managers
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to securely log in using my registered credentials, so that I can access my account and manage properties securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The login page must be accessible to property managers.
Authentication should be done through registered email and password.
The system must validate the credentials against the stored data securely.
On successful login, redirect the property manager to the dashboard.
Provide error messages for incorrect credentials.
Ensure the process adheres to security best practices, including data encryption.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want the platform to enforce role-based access controls, so that all users can access only the features and data pertinent to their roles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Define access roles within the system (Property Managers, Tenants, Subcontractors).
Property managers should have permissions to manage property listings, tenant applications, financials, and maintenance requests.
Ensure tenants have access only to their profile, lease applications, and ability to make payments.
Subcontractors should only access the job marketplace and manage job offers and invoices.
A mechanism must be in place to verify the role of the user upon login and direct them to the appropriate interface.
Access control violations should be logged and reported to system administrators.

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery for Property Managers
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to recover my password if I forget it, so that I can regain access to my account without compromising security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide a 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
Upon request, prompt the user to enter their registered email address.
Send a password reset link to the specified email only if it is associated with an existing account.
Ensure the reset link is time-bound (e.g., valid for 1 hour).
Allow the user to set a new password after verifying through the link.
Confirm password reset via email after the process is successfully completed.

User Stories.Title: Manage Property Listings
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to add, update, and remove property listings, so that I can keep the property data current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide interfaces for adding, updating, and removing listings.
Ensure that changes can only be made by property managers or higher roles.
Each action must be logged for audit purposes.
The updated listings should be immediately visible on the platform.
Allow bulk updates and deletion options for managing multiple properties.
Provide confirmation prompts for delete actions to prevent accidental data loss.

User Stories.Title: View Financial Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view financial reports and analytics, so that I can make informed decisions about the properties under my management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Allow access to financial reports from the dashboard.
Reports should include data on current month's revenue, outstanding payments, and occupancy rates.
Provide filtering options for different properties or time periods.
Ensure data accuracy and real-time updates to reflect recent transactions.
Include export options for reports in PDF or Excel formats.
Reports must be viewable only by property managers and higher roles to maintain confidentiality.

Property Managers.Title: User Role Management
Property Managers.Description: Create and manage different user roles within the platform, specifically focusing on roles under property management like secondary property managers or administrative staff.

User Stories.Title: Create Secondary Property Manager Accounts
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to create and manage secondary property manager accounts so that I can delegate specific management responsibilities to my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to create an account with username, email, and password.
Ability to assign specific properties to the secondary manager's account.
Interface for managing permissions specific to property-related tasks.
Successful login and logout functionality for secondary managers.
Email notification sent to secondary managers upon account creation.

User Stories.Title: Define Permissions for Secondary Property Managers
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to define and customize permissions for secondary property managers so that they can operate within their designated responsibilities without compromising system security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to set permissions related to property listings management, tenant interactions, and financial transactions.
UI for selecting and modifying permissions.
Changes should be saved and reflected immediately upon confirmation.
Secondary managers should only access features and data as per their permissions.

User Stories.Title: Reset Password for Secondary Property Manager
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to provide a secure way for secondary property managers to reset their passwords so that account security is maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: Secondary property managers can initiate a password reset.
Email with password reset link sent to the registered email address.
Successful password update allows login with new credentials.
All sessions are logged out upon password reset.

User Stories.Title: Remove Secondary Property Manager
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to remove secondary property manager accounts so that I can ensure system integrity and manage staff changes effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to select and remove a secondary property manager account.
Confirmation prompt before deletion to prevent accidental removals.
All associated data with the manager is securely handled and access is revoked.
Audit log entry created for the account removal activity.

User Stories.Title: Audit Trail for Secondary Property Managers
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to view an audit trail for secondary property managers so that I can track changes and actions performed by them within the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Access to a detailed log of actions taken by secondary property managers.
Filter options by date, type of action, and secondary manager involved.
Read-only access to ensure the integrity of the audit log.
Export functionality for audit logs in CSV format.

Property Managers.Title: Security and Compliance
Property Managers.Description: Ensure the platform conforms to Canadian laws for data protection and privacy, implementing necessary security protocols for safeguarding user data.

User Stories.Title: Data Encryption
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want all sensitive data to be encrypted both in transit and at rest, so that user information is secured against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data transmitted over the network must be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Data stored in the database must be encrypted using AES-256 or an equivalent standard.
Automated tests must confirm encryption on all sensitive fields.

User Stories.Title: Compliance Audits
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want the system to undergo regular compliance audits, so that it adheres to Canadian data protection and privacy laws.
AcceptanceCriteria: A compliance report should be generated every quarter.
The report must detail adherence to laws such as PIPEDA.
Non-compliance issues must be flagged and addressed promptly.

User Stories.Title: User Consent Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want a feature that allows users to give or revoke their consent for data use, so that we comply with user consent requirements under Canadian law.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can easily access and modify their consent preferences.
All changes in consent are logged and timestamped.
Users are notified of any changes in data usage policies.

User Stories.Title: Data Access Logs
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want detailed logs of who accesses user data and when, so that we can ensure accountability and traceability in compliance with Canadian law.
AcceptanceCriteria: Logs must capture the identity of the accessor, timestamp, and type of access.
Logs should be securely stored and only accessible to authorized personnel.
Log integrity must be ensured to prevent tampering.

User Stories.Title: User Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want users to be able to request access to their stored personal data, so that we comply with the transparency and user access guidelines of Canadian data protection laws.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can submit a data access request through their account settings.
Data must be provided in a commonly used format within 30 days of the request.
Procedures for data access must be documented and reviewed regularly.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Deletion
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want a feature that allows for secure deletion of user data when no longer needed or upon user request, ensuring compliance with data retention laws.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data deletion requests by users must be processed within 30 days.
Deletion must be confirmed to the user via email.
All copies of the data in backups must also be deleted in accordance with the policy.

User Stories.Title: Security Breach Notification
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want an automated system to notify users and regulatory bodies in the event of a data breach, so that we comply with legal obligations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications must be sent within 72 hours of breach discovery.
Notification must include details of the data affected and steps taken to mitigate the breach.
A log of all breach notifications must be maintained.

Property Managers.Title: Platform Customization and Settings
Property Managers.Description: Allow property managers to customize platform settings such as notification preferences, report configurations, and interface layouts.

User Stories.Title: Customize Notification Settings
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to customize my notification settings, so that I can receive alerts relevant to my specific needs and preferences.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can enable or disable specific types of notifications (e.g., payment reminders, maintenance updates).
Changes must be saved and take immediate effect.
Property Manager can specify delivery methods (email, SMS, in-app).
System should verify and confirm changes with a confirmation message.

User Stories.Title: Configure Report Settings
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to configure report settings, so that I can receive tailored reports that help me monitor the performance and status of properties effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can select types of reports to receive (e.g., financial, occupancy).
Ability to schedule reports on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.
Option to receive reports via email or accessible through the platform.
System confirms any adjustments to settings with a confirmation message.

User Stories.Title: Adjust Interface Layouts
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to adjust interface layouts, so that I can personalize the dashboard to highlight information that is most important to my day-to-day operations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can add, remove, or rearrange elements on the dashboard.
Support drag-and-drop functionality for rearranging components.
Layout changes should be auto-saved and persist upon subsequent logins.
System should provide an option to reset layout to default settings.

User Stories.Title: Manage Access Permissions
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to manage access permissions for my team, so that I can control the scope of actions they can perform on the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property Manager can define roles (e.g., assistant manager, maintenance staff) and assign permissions.
Permissions settings include read, write, modify, and delete actions for various features.
System should log and display changes to permissions for auditing.
Ensure changes are effective immediately after confirmation.

User Stories.Title: Customize Payment Processing Options
User Stories.Description: As a Property Manager, I want to customize payment processing options, so that I can streamline rent collection and other financial transactions efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to select preferred payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal).
Option to configure payment terms, late fees, and reminders.
System must provide secure processing and storage of financial data in compliance with applicable laws.
Property Manager receives confirmation of any changes made to the payment settings.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Authentication
Tenants.Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Login
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to log in using my registered email and password so that I can access my personal dashboard and manage my rental details securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant must be able to enter an email and password.
System validates credentials against the database.
Tenant is redirected to their personal dashboard upon successful login.
An error message is displayed if the login fails.

User Stories.Title: Remember Me Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want the system to remember my login credentials on my device so that I do not have to re-enter them every time I access the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Option for 'Remember Me' is visible on the login page.
If selected, the system stores the Tenant's credentials securely.
On subsequent visits, the login fields are pre-populated with the stored credentials.
Tenant must be able to opt-out of this feature by deselecting 'Remember Me'.

User Stories.Title: Forgot Password
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: A 'Forgot Password' link is available on the login page.
Tenant can enter their registered email address to receive a reset link.
Tenant receives an email with a link to reset their password.
Tenant can create a new password after clicking the reset link.
Tenant can log in with the new password.

User Stories.Title: Logout Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to securely log out from the platform so that I can ensure my account remains secure when I'm not using it.
AcceptanceCriteria: A 'Logout' option is available in the user interface.
Clicking 'Logout' ends the session and redirects the user to the login page.
After logging out, user must log in again to access personal data.

User Stories.Title: Session Timeout
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want my login session to automatically timeout after a period of inactivity so that my account is protected from unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Session times out after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Tenant is notified about the impending timeout 1 minute before with an option to extend the session.
Upon timeout, the Tenant is automatically logged out and redirected to the login page.
Tenant must log in again to access the account.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Profile Management
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Profile Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to create my profile with personal and contact information so that I can manage my rental interactions securely and efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can enter and save personal information such as full name, date of birth, and contact details.
Tenant can upload a photograph for identification.
The system validates mandatory fields and provides error messages if incomplete.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Profile Viewing
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view my profile details so that I can verify my personal information and ensure it is up to date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can view all personal and contact information previously entered.
Profile viewing is secure and only accessible after tenant login.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Profile Update
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to update my profile with new or changed personal and contact information so that my rental interactions remain current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can edit and save changes to any personal or contact information.
The system confirms successful updates with a notification.

User Stories.Title: Manage Bank/Card Details
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage my bank or card details for payments so that I can handle my financial transactions securely within the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can add, view, and delete bank or card information.
The platform provides secure data handling compliant with financial regulations.

User Stories.Title: Document Handling
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to upload, view, and manage my documents such as lease agreements and identity proofs so that I can maintain necessary records digitally.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can upload documents in supported formats (e.g., PDF, JPG).
Tenant can view a list of all uploaded documents.
Tenant can delete documents no longer needed.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Login
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to log in to the platform using my registered credentials so that I can access my personal tenant profile and related functionalities securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can log in using an email address and password.
The system provides error messages for invalid login attempts.
Successful login directs the tenant to their dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to recover or reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my profile without compromising security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can initiate a password reset via a registered email link.
Tenant receives clear instructions for resetting their password.
The system confirms the successful password update.

Tenants.Title: Property Search and Listings
Tenants.Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.

User Stories.Title: Search Properties with Filters
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to search for properties using various filters such as location, price range, and amenities so that I can find listings that match my specific needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can select multiple filters such as location, property type, number of rooms, and price range.
Filters for advanced options like pet policy and amenities are available and functional.
Results update dynamically as filters are applied.
No results found message is displayed when no properties match the criteria.

User Stories.Title: View Property Details
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view detailed information about properties so that I can assess if the property fits my requirements before scheduling a visit or applying.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detailed page for each property listing is accessible.
Property details include images, floor plans, property rules, amenities, and contact information.
All listed details are correctly populated from the database.

User Stories.Title: Save/Bookmark Properties
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to save or bookmark properties so that I can easily return to them later without having to search again.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can click a save or bookmark icon on the property listings.
Saved properties are accessible through a 'Saved Properties' section in the user's profile.
Tenants can remove properties from their saved list.

User Stories.Title: Property Application
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to apply for a lease directly from the property details page so that I can initiate the rental process efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: A 'Apply for Lease' button is available on each property detail page.
Clicking the button opens a form where the tenant can submit their application.
Confirmation is shown after successfully submitting the application.
The property owner receives the application for review.

User Stories.Title: Schedule Property Visits
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to schedule visits to properties I am interested in using an integrated calendar so that I can see the property in person at a convenient time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can view available time slots and schedule appointments through a calendar interface integrated with the property details page.
Email confirmation is sent to the tenant and property manager upon scheduling.
Tenants can reschedule or cancel appointments with notifications sent to property managers.

User Stories.Title: Manage Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage my profile information so that I can ensure my contact details and preferences are up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can access their profile from a user dashboard.
Editable fields include phone number, email, and password.
Changes can be saved directly, with confirmation of successful updates.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Login
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to log into my account using my registered credentials so that I can access personalized features like saved properties and profile management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login page accepts username (or email) and password.
Successful login redirects to the tenant's dashboard.
Error message displayed for incorrect credentials.

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to recover my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account without losing my saved data.
AcceptanceCriteria: Password recovery option is available on the login page.
Tenant can enter their email to receive a password reset link.
Tenant can set a new password using the link.

Tenants.Title: Lease Application and Management
Tenants.Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Lease Application Submission
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to submit lease applications through the platform so that I can apply for rental units quickly and efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can fill out an application form with necessary details.
Tenant can submit the completed application form.
System validates the data before submission to ensure all required fields are filled.
Tenant receives confirmation of submission.

User Stories.Title: View Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view the status of my lease applications so that I can stay updated on the progress and plan accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access a dashboard showing all submitted applications.
Each application displays its current status (e.g., pending, accepted, rejected).
Updates to application status are shown in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Manage Ongoing Leases
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage my ongoing leases through the platform to easily access lease details and related documents anytime.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can view a list of all active leases.
Access detailed view of each lease including terms, payment schedules, and documents.
Functionality to download or request physical copies of lease documents.

User Stories.Title: Lease Renewal Management
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to manage lease renewals through the platform so that I can easily extend my stay without administrative hassles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notification alerts tenant of upcoming lease expiration two months in advance.
Tenant can initiate lease renewal directly through the platform.
System guides tenant through any changes in terms or conditions for the renewal process.

User Stories.Title: Lease Termination Initiation
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to initiate lease terminations when necessary so that I can end my lease officially and in compliance with rental agreements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can request lease termination from the platform.
Tenant must confirm the request after being shown any potential fees or penalties.
Tenant receives a checklist of tasks to complete before vacating (e.g., cleaning, key return).
Confirmation of lease termination is recorded and visible in the tenant’s history.

User Stories.Title: Password Recovery/Reset
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to recover or reset my password so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can request a password reset from the login page.
Tenant receives a password reset link via email.
Tenant can create a new password following secure password guidelines.
Tenant can log in with the new password.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log into the platform so that my personal and lease information remains protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant logs in using a username and password.
System provides an option for two-factor authentication for enhanced security.
Session timeout after a period of inactivity for security purposes.

Tenants.Title: Payment Management
Tenants.Description: Enable tenants to make secure payments for rent and security deposits, view their payment history, and manage their payment methods.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Secure Login
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log into my account using my email and password so that I can access my payment and lease information securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can enter email and password to log in
System validates credentials and grants access
Login attempt is secure and encrypted
Forgot password and reset options are available

User Stories.Title: View Payment History
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view my past payment history so that I can keep track of all my rent and deposit transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access a section with historical payment data
Payment history includes date, amount, and payment method details
Data is displayed in a chronological order
Tenant can download the payment history as a PDF

User Stories.Title: Make Secure Payment
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to make secure payments for rent and security deposits using integrated payment methods like credit card or bank transfer so that I can ensure my transactions are safe and recorded.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can choose from multiple payment methods (credit card, bank transfer)
Payment process is integrated with Stripe for secure processing
Tenant receives confirmation of payment via email and in-app notification
Payment details are updated in real-time in the tenant’s payment history

User Stories.Title: Manage Payment Methods
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to add, remove, and manage my stored payment methods so that I can easily control how I pay for rent and deposits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access a payment method management interface
Options to add new payment methods with form validations
Ability to remove existing payment methods with confirmation prompt
Changes are saved immediately and securely

User Stories.Title: Set Up Recurring Payments
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to set up recurring payments for my rent so that I can automate the payment process and avoid late payments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can opt-in for recurring payments via their payment settings
Tenant can select the date for the recurring payment each month
System sends reminders two days before the scheduled payment
Tenant can cancel or modify the recurring payment settings anytime

User Stories.Title: Secure Account Logout
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log out from my account so that I can ensure my account remains secure after I’ve finished my session.
AcceptanceCriteria: Log out option is easily accessible from all pages
Session is completely terminated after logging out
Tenant is redirected to the login page after logging out
Confirmation message is displayed post-logout

Tenants.Title: Maintenance Request System
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to submit maintenance requests, track the status of these requests, and communicate with property managers and subcontractors regarding these requests.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Maintenance Request Submission
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit maintenance requests through the platform, so that I can report issues without delay and ensure they are addressed promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can log into their dashboard.
Tenant can fill out a form detailing the maintenance issue, including type of issue, description, urgency, and the ability to attach photos or videos.
Tenant can submit the request which is then visible to the property manager and relevant subcontractors.
Tenants receive a confirmation notification/email when the request is submitted.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Track Maintenance Request Status
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to track the status of my maintenance requests, so that I can stay informed about the progress and resolution of my issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can view a list of all submitted maintenance requests in their dashboard.
Each request shows current status (Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Completed).
Tenants receive real-time updates when the status of their request changes.

User Stories.Title: Tenant-Subcontractor Communication
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to communicate directly with subcontractors, so that I can discuss maintenance issues, schedule appointments, or provide further details as necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Once a maintenance request is accepted, a chat window is enabled between the tenant and the assigned subcontractor.
Messages can include text and the ability to attach images or documents.
Both parties receive notifications of new messages in the chat interface and via email.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance Request Review and Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to provide feedback on completed maintenance jobs, so that I can express satisfaction or concerns about the service provided.
AcceptanceCriteria: After a maintenance request is marked as completed, tenants can access a feedback form.
Tenants can rate the service (e.g., 1-5 stars) and provide written feedback.
Feedback is shared with the property manager and can be viewed by other tenants.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance History Access
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to access the history of all my maintenance requests, so that I can refer back to previous issues and resolutions for my records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can view a historical log of all maintenance requests from their dashboard.
The history includes detailed descriptions, dates submitted, actions taken, final status, and feedback provided.
The data is searchable by date range and type of maintenance.

Tenants.Title: Appointment Booking
Tenants.Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Authentication for Appointment Booking
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to log in securely so that I can schedule appointments with property managers or for property visits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant is able to log in using email and password.
System supports 'Forgot Password' functionality to reset password.
After login, the tenant should be redirected to the appointment booking page.

User Stories.Title: View Available Time Slots
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view available time slots for property visits so that I can choose a slot that fits my schedule.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can see a calendar with available slots highlighted.
The calendar integrates with the property manager’s calendar via Calendly.
Tenant can view time slots for the next 30 days.

User Stories.Title: Schedule Property Visit
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to schedule a property visit through Calendly integration so that the appointment is automatically synced with the property manager’s calendar.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant selects a time slot and schedules a visit directly.
Confirmation of the appointment is sent to the tenant’s email.
Property manager receives a notification about the scheduled visit.

User Stories.Title: Cancel or Reschedule Appointment
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to cancel or reschedule my appointment so that I can manage changes in my availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access their booked appointments from their dashboard.
Each appointment has options to reschedule or cancel.
Notifications are sent to both tenant and property manager upon cancellation or rescheduling.

User Stories.Title: Appointment Reminders
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive reminders about my appointments so that I do not miss scheduled visits.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant receives an email reminder 24 hours before the appointment.
A reminder notification is pushed through the application 1 hour before the appointment.

User Stories.Title: Feedback Submission Post-Visit
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit feedback after a property visit so that I can share my experience and any concerns.
AcceptanceCriteria: After the appointment, the tenant receives a prompt to submit feedback.
Tenant can rate the visit and submit comments through a form in the app.
Feedback is stored and can be accessed by the property manager for review.

Tenants.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Tenants.Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.

User Stories.Title: Lease Renewal Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive notifications about upcoming lease renewals so that I can make timely decisions about extending my stay or moving out.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notification is automatically triggered 60 days before the lease expiry date.
Tenant receives the notification via both email and in-app notification.
Tenant can directly navigate to the lease renewal section from the notification.

User Stories.Title: Payment Due Date Alerts
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive reminders about upcoming rent payment due dates so that I can ensure timely payments without incurring any late fees.
AcceptanceCriteria: Reminder notifications are sent 7 days before the due date.
Additional reminder if the rent is not paid, 1 day before the due date.
Tenant receives these alerts via email and in-app notifications.
Links to the payment portal are included in the notifications.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance Request Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive updates about the status of my maintenance requests so that I can stay informed about when issues will be resolved.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant receives an immediate notification when a maintenance request is accepted, rejected, or completed.
Each notification includes details about the request status and expected next steps or completion date.
Notifications are available through both in-app notifications and emails.

User Stories.Title: General Announcement Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive general announcements related to the property so that I am informed about matters affecting my tenancy.
AcceptanceCriteria: General announcements such as changes in management, major construction, or policy changes are communicated via notifications.
Tenant receives these through email and in-app notifications.
Each notification includes a summary of the announcement and links to detailed information if available.

User Stories.Title: Custom Notification Settings
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to customize my notification preferences so that I only receive relevant alerts and can choose the notification methods that suit me best.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can access a settings menu to turn on/off specific types of notifications.
Tenants can choose the method of notification (email, in-app, both).
Changes to settings must be saved and take effect immediately.

Tenants.Title: Feedback and Reviews
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Feedback Submission
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit feedback on my rental property and services provided so that I can share my experiences with the property management and other potential tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant is able to access a feedback submission form from their dashboard.
Tenant can rate aspects such as cleanliness, service responsiveness, and amenities.
Tenant can leave detailed textual feedback.
Feedback submission updates the property's overall rating in real-time.
Feedback is immediately visible in the tenant's feedback history.

User Stories.Title: View Property Reviews
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view reviews and ratings from other tenants for a specific property so that I can make informed decisions about potential rentals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access a reviews section from the property details page.
Reviews display both ratings and textual feedback.
Reviews include the date of submission and the first name of the reviewer for authenticity.
Tenant can filter reviews by date and rating.

User Stories.Title: Feedback Moderation and Management
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to edit or delete my previous feedback submissions so that I can correct errors or update my opinions as situations change.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can view their own past reviews and ratings via their profile.
Tenant has the option to edit or delete their submissions.
Changes in reviews are reflected immediately across the platform.
Notifications are sent to property managers when a review is edited or deleted.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications on Feedback Responses
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive notifications when property management responds to my feedback so that I can stay updated on dialogues concerning my reviews.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notification is sent to the tenant's dashboard and email when a response is made.
Tenant can directly access the response through links provided in the notification.
Tenant can reply to the response from the property manager.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Dashboard for Feedback Overview
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want a dashboard widget that summarizes all my given feedback, average ratings I've provided, and any responses from landlords or property managers so that I can easily track my interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard widget shows a summary of all feedback given by the tenant.
Widget displays average rating and number of reviews submitted.
Tenant receives visual notification on the widget for any new responses from property managers.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Verification
Tenants.Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.

User Stories.Title: Tenant Profile Verification Initiation
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to initiate my profile verification using SingleKey during the lease application process so that I can ensure my credentials are validated and increase my trustworthiness to potential landlords.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant initiates verification from the tenant dashboard.
Tenant is redirected to the SingleKey integration interface.
Tenant inputs required information and submits it for verification.
Tenant receives a notification upon successful submission of their verification request.

User Stories.Title: Verification Status Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive real-time updates on my verification status so that I am informed of the current progress and can take necessary actions if there are any issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant receives an in-app notification and email regarding the status of the verification.
Tenant can view the current status of their verification process on their dashboard.
The system updates the tenant's profile status automatically based on the verification results (verified or needs additional info).

User Stories.Title: Verification Payment Process
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to pay for the verification process through the platform if the property owner requires tenants to bear the cost, so that I can complete necessary financial transactions securely and conveniently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant is prompted to make a payment if the property owner has set the verification payment responsibility to the tenant.
Tenant can use Stripe integration to make the payment securely.
Tenant receives confirmation of the payment.
System records the transaction in the tenant's payment history.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling and Support for Verification
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive helpful error messages and access support if the verification process encounters issues, so that I can resolve any problems efficiently and complete my profile verification.
AcceptanceCriteria: System displays clear and specific error messages if the verification cannot be processed.
Tenant can access a FAQ or Help section regarding common verification issues.
Tenant has the option to contact support directly from the verification page.

User Stories.Title: Resubmission of Verification Documents
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want the ability to resubmit verification documents if my initial submission is rejected, so that I can correct any errors and complete the verification process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant is notified of the need for resubmission and the reasons for rejection.
Tenant can resubmit the documents through the SingleKey interface.
Tenant receives confirmation of the resubmission.
System updates the verification status accordingly.
